newsitem.title: USA: ABC Rail in Mexican joint venture.
newsitem.headline: ABC Rail in Mexican joint venture.

text.p: ABC Rail Products Corp said Monday it formed a joint venture to manufacture equipment for and supply services to the railroad industry in Mexico.
ABC said it concluded a long-term joint venture agreement with Damy Cambios de Via SA de CV based in Guadalajara. The joint venture company will also be based in Guadalajara."
The company said the joint venture represents a further step in ABC Rail's strategy to supply services and equipment components to the rebounding international heavy freight railroad industry.
Further details about the agreement were not released.
